introduction: Five rune masters hold the pieces of Malchor's lost artifact. His museum request is one story: return all five distinct runes together. Suggested questions, current supplies and optional travel preparation do not themselves award achievements.
orientation: The forest and River Moria connect Conyberry, Thundertree and the pond approach to the Tower of Twilight. The five masters hold five different rune kinds; the current delivery accepts supplied runes as well as personally recovered ones.

Ask the amethyst master about the rune, Malchor or artifact. Ask Malchor about the masters and the five rune names. These are guidance topics; each keyword is not an achievement or recorded proof of learning.

From the forest pond approach, the rock path leads to the invisible bridge and the Tower of Twilight. The guardian golem carries a wand of entry. Use, rather than its advertised wave command, is its trigger, but the ordinary reset opens the east passage already.
Follow the tower ramp to the museum. Malchor accepts one amethyst, sapphire, diamond, ruby and emerald rune together. Get them out of containers and remove any worn or held rune before offering.

The currently matched reward is a ruby-encrusted eyepatch. Other reward variants share the same complete offering and have no selection step. The journal counts this recovery once, including an older recorded variant, instead of treating it as five separate commissions.

The concealed tree-dome hole leads to a separate mirror maze with unresolved exit problems. Agatha and her horseshoe/payment lore are not prerequisites or implemented follow-on quests for Malchor. The real golden horseshoes lie elsewhere in the forest; Wicks in the Divine Home accepts them in a separate exchange.
Conyberry farming, Thundertree logging and museum projections are exploration and atmosphere. Their narrated work, healing and rescue suggestions do not implement new local completion receipts.
Quest tracking is available while economic accounting is active. Supply checks show what you carry now; a successful recorded delivery completes this story.

stories.title: Malchor's Five Runes
stories.summary: Return one of each of the five distinct rune kinds to Malchor in the Tower of Twilight museum. The current exchange awards a ruby-encrusted eyepatch and leaves him present. Supplied runes qualify. This records the artifact-piece delivery; it does not claim personal victories over the masters, every earlier journey or a new restored-world effect.

steps.text: Optional: keep the wand of entry available for the invisible bridge
steps.hint: The guardian golem carries the wand. Use it at the invisible bridge if the east passage is blocked; its inscription says wave, but use is the actual trigger. The reviewed reset already opens this passage, so the wand is preparation rather than a required personal history.

steps.hint: Seek Malchor in the Tower of Twilight museum. Carry the runes directly rather than offering a container or worn equipment.
